steps.say: A sample must be registered before a trial can be filed under it. Press New sample.
Type the sample ID and pick its material. A photo is optional for a sample (a flake needs one); press Add photo to attach one, or press Next.
Press Add sample to save it.
A chip belongs to the sample picked above. Press New chip.
Type the chip ID and press Add chip.
A flake belongs to the chip picked above. Press New flake.
Type the flake ID and press Add flake. The sample, chip and flake now appear in the pickers.
